pricing.note: Prices are in shares: one share is one made day's pay for one player. Node price = (price_shares + extra_per_owned * nodes already owned) * share. The first node costs about one share; each later node costs one share more than the last.

deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
deep_pockets.description: The same item stacks three to a slot.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: When winded, press sprint again to refill your stamina at once.
second_wind.drawback: You gasp loudly. Once a floor.

long_burn.name: Long Burn
long_burn.description: Glow Sticks last twice as long. Flashbulbs count as looking for two seconds.

soft_shoes.name: Soft Shoes
soft_shoes.description: Footsteps carry a quarter less far.

quick_fingers.name: Quick Fingers
quick_fingers.description: Search in half the time without noise.

nodes.name: Flashbulb
nodes.description: Once a floor, fire a flash. For one second the dark ahead is lit, and that second counts as looking.
nodes.drawback: Your own screen is white for two seconds after.

nodes.name: Whistle
nodes.description: Whistle on a key. Your crewmates hear exactly where you are.
nodes.drawback: It is a noise. A Hearing resident will come.

nodes.name: Marker Pad
nodes.description: Your own pad of two marks, in your colour, on top of the crew's shared three.

nodes.name: Doorstop
nodes.description: Hold the lift doors from the landing, not only from inside.
nodes.drawback: Outside the car you can be caught.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: Once a floor, when winded, press sprint again to refill your stamina at once.
nodes.drawback: You gasp loudly, and the next time you are winded lasts longer.
